issues.title: Selection Between Barrier Execution Alternatives A, B, and C
issues.description: Choosing whether to preserve original close[i] barriers (Alternative A), re-anchor economic barriers to open[i+1] (Alternative B), or decouple directional signals from an independent trade exit policy (Alternative C).
issues.recommended_resolution: Alternative B for pure barrier strategy evaluation, or Alternative C for practical systematic execution.

issues.title: Directional Short Exploitation Symmetry Proof
issues.description: Validating whether predicting Class -1 (downward barrier touch) generates profitable short returns after costs with equal efficacy as Class +1 long returns.
issues.recommended_resolution: Mandate separate long-only, short-only, and combined PnL reporting in Phase 5.5.

issues.title: Historical 8-Hour Funding Rate Dataset Acquisition
issues.description: Canonical repository datasets lack empirical funding rates, necessitating parametric sensitivity modeling until external historical records are backfilled.
issues.recommended_resolution: Authorize external backfill of Binance/Bybit historical funding rates or approve parametric sensitivity grid.

issues.title: Dynamic Slippage Scaling Coefficients Alpha and Beta
issues.description: Parameters alpha=0.05 and beta=0.0010 are derived from academic literature rather than empirical exchange fill logs.
issues.recommended_resolution: Maintain 20 bps and 30 bps stress testing gates to ensure robustness against parameter miscalibration.

issues.title: Multi-Asset Concurrency Queue Tie-Breaking Protocol
issues.description: Protocol when more than 3 specialists trigger simultaneous signals with equal calibrated confidence.
issues.recommended_resolution: Enforce secondary tie-breaking by instrument liquidity (highest 24h quote volume wins).
